description: Read one tab of the LetsBot Reports page for a period: KPI cards with the change vs the previous period, the main chart (labels + series), the table rows (max 100) and footnotes. Tabs: conversations (opened/closed/open), responses (reply speed), resolutions, messages (inbound/outbound, delivery), contacts (new contacts by channel, ads vs organic), assignments, lifecycle, calls (WhatsApp calls) and broadcasts (campaign delivery and replies). Call with no tab to get the list of tabs available in this workspace. Same numbers the merchant sees in the panel for the same period. Read-only.

channel.description: Only this channel. Omit for all channels.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD) when period is custom. Max range 366 days.

group_by.description: Table/chart grouping. Each tab supports only some values (listed in available_tabs[].group_by_options); an unsupported value falls back to the tab's default.

period.description: Period preset in the workspace time zone. Default 30d. Use custom with from and to.

tab.description: Which report tab. Omit to list the tabs available in this workspace and what each one shows.

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) when period is custom.

name: get_report
